title: 2one DLS component entry
description: Contract for a component's machine-readable metadata (per PRD: every component entry must carry name, source, formats, status, and last-updated). Used to validate future per-component .json output.

name.description: Component name (shadcn/ui naming), e.g. Button, Select.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the source, e.g. src/components/ui/button.tsx.

formats.description: Formats this component is available in.

figma_source.description: Traceability to the Figma source (PRD FR-2).

last_updated_commit.description: Git SHA of the last change.
